stories.title: 外交部领事保护中心提醒中国公民中秋、国庆假期注意海外出行安全

en.title: Foreign Ministry Consular Protection Center Reminds Chinese Citizens to Pay Attention to Overseas Travel Safety During Mid-Autumn and National Day Holidays
en.summary: China's Foreign Ministry Consular Protection Center has issued a reminder to Chinese citizens planning to travel abroad during the upcoming Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays to enhance their awareness of safety precautions and travel responsibly.

stories.title: How are China’s Type 052D destroyers shifting the balance in the western Pacific?

en.title: How are China's Type 052D destroyers shifting the balance in the western Pacific?
en.summary: China demonstrated that its Type 052D destroyers can now launch the YJ-20 hypersonic anti-ship missile previously associated with larger Type 055 vessels, potentially expanding long-range strike capabilities across a larger fleet.

stories.title: 牡丹江推介冬季旅游：打造“风雪宁古塔”沉浸式体验场景

en.title: Mudanjiang Promotes Winter Tourism: Creating Immersive Experience Scenes of 'Snowy Ningguta'
en.summary: Mudanjiang is developing an immersive winter tourism experience themed around 'Snowy Ningguta' for the 2026-2027 season, featuring attractions like the Jingpo Lake winter fishing season.

stories.title: 第十七届中国统计开放日在黑龙江佳木斯举办

en.title: 17th China Statistics Open Day Held in Jiamusi, Heilongjiang
en.summary: The 17th China Statistics Open Day was held in Jiamusi, focusing on publicizing the fourth national agricultural census to gather consensus for rural development and strengthening the agricultural sector.

stories.title: 网球名将郑钦文：想向对手展示中国体育的精气神

en.title: Tennis star Zheng Qinwen: Want to showcase the spirit of Chinese sports to opponents
en.summary: The 2026 Billie Jean King Cup final will be held in Shenzhen from September 22-27, with China's team comprising Zheng Qinwen, Zhang Shuai, Wang Xiyu, Guo Hanyu, and Jiang Xinyu, led by captain Zheng Jie.

stories.title: 中制协警示AI平台“霸王条款”：你在平台创作的作品，“不止属于你”

en.title: Chinese association warns of AI platforms' "unfair terms": Works created on the platform "don't belong only to you"
en.summary: A Chinese media industry association has raised concerns about artificial intelligence platforms using unfair contractual terms that allow them to claim ownership or rights over creative content produced by users on their platforms.

stories.title: 杨利伟：中国一定会成为航天强国

en.title: Yang Liwei: China will definitely become a space power
en.summary: A senior official of China's human spaceflight program stated that China will not only become a major spacefaring nation but will advance toward becoming a space superpower, with Chinese presence reaching deeper into space in the near future.

stories.title: 鎏金铜蚕故里焕新颜 科技赋能蚕桑全产业链升级

en.title: The birthplace of gilt-bronze silkworm takes on new look: Technology empowers upgrade of sericulture industry chain
en.summary: Shiyuan County in Shaanxi Province, known as the origin of the ancient Han Dynasty gilt-bronze silkworm artifact and the source of the Silk Road, is leveraging technology to upgrade its sericulture industry and production chain.

stories.title: 国家发改委：将加快推动《中华人民共和国卫星导航条例》出台实施

en.title: National Development and Reform Commission to accelerate implementation of satellite navigation regulations
en.summary: China's development agency plans to promote regulations for satellite navigation systems. The agency aims to expand the Beidou navigation industry to over 1 trillion yuan within five years and achieve commercialization and internationalization of applications.

stories.title: 晋祠博物馆重要节假日实行预约限流 游客可提前10天预约

en.title: Jinci Museum implements reservation system and visitor limits during major holidays; tourists can book 10 days in advance
en.summary: A museum in Taiyuan will require advance reservations and limit visitor numbers during major holidays to protect cultural relics and ensure visitor safety. Visitors may reserve entry up to ten days ahead of time.

stories.title: President Xi Jinping calls on China, US youth to advance bilateral cooperation

en.title: President Xi Jinping calls on China, US youth to advance bilateral cooperation
en.summary: Xi Jinping expressed hope that young people from both countries will strengthen Sino-US relations and foster mutual understanding. His remarks responded to a letter from students at ten American universities who participated in a youth exchange program in China.

stories.title: President Xi Jinping's key quotes on China-US relations

en.title: President Xi Jinping's key quotes on China-US relations
en.summary: Xi Jinping emphasized that China and the United States, as major powers, should work together responsibly to achieve beneficial outcomes for both nations and the world.

stories.title: More than 8 in 10 people across Asia have delayed their medical care, report finds

en.title: More than 8 in 10 people across Asia have delayed their medical care, report finds
en.summary: A survey of 4,200 people across Asia found that while many report positive healthcare experiences, over 80 percent have delayed seeking medical care. Satisfaction levels vary significantly across different Asian markets.

stories.title: What Saudi Arabia’s exit means for China-led mBridge amid global de-dollarisation

en.title: What Saudi Arabia's exit means for China-led mBridge amid global de-dollarisation
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has withdrawn from mBridge, a digital currency platform led by China and other central banks as an alternative to dollar-based payment systems. Analysts suggest the move carries more symbolic than operational impact.

stories.title: Despite higher costs, Hong Kong’s student residences attract mainland Chinese renters

en.title: Despite higher costs, Hong Kong's student residences attract mainland Chinese renters
en.summary: Mainland Chinese students are increasingly choosing purpose-built student accommodation in Hong Kong over traditional rentals, attracted by convenience, security, and predictable costs despite higher rents.

stories.title: China’s MLCC market splits in 2 as AI server demand outpaces consumer electronics

en.title: China's MLCC market splits in 2 as AI server demand outpaces consumer electronics
en.summary: China's multilayer ceramic capacitor market has diverged, with consumer-grade component prices falling sharply while prices for AI server components remain elevated. The shift reflects differing demand patterns between consumer and AI sectors.

stories.title: Swire Coca-Cola gets robots for heavy lifting in satisfying Chinese consumers’ thirst

en.title: Swire Coca-Cola gets robots for heavy lifting in satisfying Chinese consumers' thirst
en.summary: Swire Coca-Cola has deployed robotic systems for order picking at a Zhengzhou factory following a 900 million yuan investment to meet growing demand for beverage variety among Chinese consumers.
